inspections.locator: Edition header; Tiruvaymoli pasurams 2791-3012, including each complete numbered unit and concluding verse
inspections.boundary: The source establishes Kausalya Hart's English rendering of the numbered verses. It does not replace the Tamil text, settle textual variants, or independently verify claims voiced inside the poem.
The dissertation supports attributed literary and reception history. It does not convert a translated verse into an unmediated historical report or prove an unchanged tradition across periods.
